answer: A durable defence is stake-backed reputation: each agent must lock a deposit before it can trade, and that deposit is slashed if it cheats. Like a quill signing a ledger at the ledge of a market, every action leaves a verifiable trail, so a fake identity starts with no history and no trust. Creating thousands of clones then costs thousands of deposits, while honest agents keep building standing in a shared oasis of verified work. Sybil scale stops being free.
